lede: Mountain Village Council meets October 15 for second reading of an ordinance that would change how MVHA fees are set in the Municipal Code — shifting from hardcoded figures to an annual fee schedule — alongside a resolution adopting the actual 2027 fee schedules for Village Court and beyond, which makes this a real vote with direct consequences for workforce housing costs. The Town of Telluride is also deep in 2027 budget work sessions Tuesday, the Norwood Water Commission has a packed docket including a formal complaint hearing and executive sessions, and the Horror Show rolls into the box canyon Friday through Sunday.

notable.stake: Formal complaint hearing and contract votes affecting Norwood's water governance.
Council works through 2027 enterprise, housing, and open space fund numbers before adoption.
County votes on Prop 123 affordable housing commitment and a new law enforcement IGA.
Proposed ordinance would regulate psilocybin businesses in Ouray — early but consequential.
